question: Which Nutrisigma supplementation level for Garole lambs is concluded to be economically most viable, and what final body condition score did that group reach?
expect: 10 g/head/day (T1); final BCS 3.20 (from 2.65) (Table 4, p4; conclusion p5)
rendered:
The answer is contained in document "Impact of Nutrisigma on performance of young Garole lambs".

The economically most viable level of Nutrisigma supplementation is 10 g/head/day (document, page 3: "So, it may be concluded that supplementation of Nutrisigma® with concentrate mixture could be used economically up to 20 g/head/day without any harmful effect on growth performance, however; the use of Nutrisigma® 10 g/head/day is economically more viable for Garole lambs.").

The final body condition score reached by this group is 3.20 (document, page 4: "Final BCS | 2.72 | 3.20 | 3.10 |").
